6 hobbies that make you
dangerously brilliant

1. playing chess

it teaches you to think
several moves ahead

2. listening to classical music

with the story behind it.
every symphony has one

3. learning the basics
of a new language

even 10 words a week
makes a difference

4. keeping a quote journal

write down the sentences
that moved you

5. going to open lectures

museums and libraries
host them for free

6. an evening lesson
instead of scrolling

5 minutes on art,
history or science
